steps: Collectors buffer spans sharing a trace ID.
They wait until completion or a bounded timeout reveals outcome.
Policy favors errors, slow traces, or rare attributes.
All available spans for selected traces are exported together.

lesson.scenario: Collectors retain rare failures and slow traces after observing complete outcomes instead of deciding at request start.
